cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies between 22 and 42 weeks of gestation who delivered at a university hospital level-3 maternity ward over a 16-year period
finding: Attempted vaginal delivery in face presentations triples the cesarean risk compared to vertex presentations, but more than two-thirds of women with face presentations give birth vaginally without any impairment of neonatal condition.
mod_finding: Cesarean rate during labor was three times higher for face presentations compared to vertex presentations.
